identify_person.title: Add or update a person
identify_person.description: Create or update a person and their traits. Traits are merged, not replaced, so sending one attribute leaves the rest intact. This is the call that makes someone addressable by a campaign.

traits.description: The person's attributes, merged into whatever is already stored.

user_id.description: Your own id for the person. Use this or `anonymousId`; a call with neither is rejected.

anonymous_id.description: A pre-identification id for someone you do not yet know. Merge it into a real profile later with alias_profiles.

timestamp.description: When the event happened, ISO 8601. Omit for now; set it when backfilling so the event lands in the right place in history.

context.description: Device, page, campaign and locale context, as the Segment-style context object.

integrations.description: Per-destination routing overrides, keyed by destination name.

message_id.description: Your own id for this call, used to deduplicate retries.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

track_event.title: Track an event
track_event.description: Record something a person did. Events are what trigger campaigns, so this is the main write in a Customer.io integration. It is also how deletions and suppressions are performed -- see the semantic event names in the pack header.

event.description: The event name, e.g. "Order Completed". Certain names are semantic -- see the pack header.

user_id.description: Your own id for the person. Use this or `anonymousId`; a call with neither is rejected.

anonymous_id.description: A pre-identification id for someone you do not yet know. Merge it into a real profile later with alias_profiles.

timestamp.description: When the event happened, ISO 8601. Omit for now; set it when backfilling so the event lands in the right place in history.

integrations.description: Per-destination routing overrides, keyed by destination name.

message_id.description: Your own id for this call, used to deduplicate retries.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

track_page_view.title: Track a page view
track_page_view.description: Record that a person viewed a web page, with its name, url and referrer. Distinct from a generic event so Customer.io can treat browsing behaviour as its own signal.

group_object.title: Create an object or relationship
group_object.description: Associate a person with an object -- an account, a workspace, a subscription -- and set that object's attributes. This is how Customer.io models anything that is not a single person.

object_type_id.description: Which object type this is, when the workspace defines several.

user_id.description: Your own id for the person. Use this or `anonymousId`; a call with neither is rejected.

alias_profiles.title: Merge two profiles
alias_profiles.description: Merge an anonymous profile into a known one, so behaviour recorded before sign-up is attributed to the person afterwards. Merging is not reversible -- the two histories become one.

previous_id.description: The id being merged from, usually an anonymousId.

anonymous_id.description: The anonymous id, when the merge is expressed that way round.

message_id.description: Your own id for this call, used to deduplicate retries.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.

send_batch.title: Send a batch of calls
send_batch.description: Send many identify, track, page, screen and group calls in one request. The batch may total 500KB with each individual call under 32KB. This is how a backfill should be shaped -- one call per record will hit the rate limit long before the batch endpoint does.

batch.description: The calls to send, each an object with a `type` of identify, track, page, screen or group plus that call's own fields.

context.description: Context applied to every call in the batch.

integrations.description: Per-destination routing overrides for the whole batch.

output.description: The provider's response to the call.
